summary: Practise supplier risk mapping, grievance design, and HREDD documentation aligned with CSDDD and OECD guidance. Explore the course.
lede: Human rights and environmental due diligence (HREDD) training helps procurement, sustainability, and legal professionals organize supplier-risk work. Participants practise mapping supplier relationships, prioritizing potential and actual impacts, and planning prevention, mitigation, grievance, and remediation steps. They also develop audit plans and document decisions and evidence to support follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape supplier decisions, assess impacts, manage complaints, or document HREDD actions across complex value chains.
prerequisites: Prior experience in procurement, supply chain, sustainability, legal, compliance, or supplier management is recommended. Familiarity with supplier due diligence or human rights and environmental risk is useful. No coding or programming is required.
